Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Events | National Lali X Lola brings musical excitement to Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 at Ghud Park Source : Emmanuel Tetteh 14 November 2026 8:00pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 is getting even more exciting, with Ghanaian music duo Lali X Lola adding a musical dimension to the three-day exhibition at Ghud Park, Accra Mall.
The duo's performance is giving patrons another reason to enjoy the fair, as shopping, networking, entertainment and the celebration of Ghanaian entrepreneurship combine to create a lively atmosphere.
Their appearance adds to the growing excitement at the exhibition, which has brought together more than 80 brands showcasing products and services across food and beverages, fashion, beauty, agriculture, technology, electronics and lifestyle.
The fair, powered by JoyPrime in partnership with Ecobank, is running from November 13 to 15, 2026, providing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with an opportunity to showcase their products, attract new customers and increase their market visibility.
Beyond the music, patrons can explore a wide range of Ghanaian products, enjoy special offers and interact directly with entrepreneurs behind some of the country's emerging brands.
Joy Prime's KMJ has also been adding excitement through engagements with exhibitors and visitors.
The event builds on the success of the maiden edition in 2025, which attracted more than 160 exhibitors bringing visitors on its opening day.
With the Lali X Lola performance adding to the attractions, organisers are encouraging the public to visit Ghud Park, Accra Mall, before the fair closes on Sunday, November 15.
It is an opportunity to shop, enjoy great music, discover local brands and support Ghanaian businesses.
